account:
Today has mostly followed my ordinary appointments: correspondence, the market walk, lunch at home, town accounts, and now tea with my neighbour at the dockside cottage. I have just asked the neighbour how the day went and whether the builder found the innkeeper and freight operator; I have not yet heard an answer.

There are a few things worth noticing. The builder has been looking for both the innkeeper and freight operator. My neighbour said it was business, but did not know what business, and had heard of no trouble. I saw the innkeeper around town hall late this morning, but did not manage to speak with him. A lantern appeared in the great hall at (-58, -60, 32); I do not know who placed it or why.

Through the secretary, the innkeeper requested a thirty-minute meeting tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall, concerning civic hospitality and community gatherings, with himself and a committee. He specifically asked the secretary to escort me. I approved and asked for the committee members' names and an agenda. I have not received those details or confirmation that the appointment was entered. The secretary reported no account figures, payments, council letters, or other actionable news today.

My best tentative explanation is that the innkeeper and others are organizing some community gathering, perhaps with practical help from the builder and freight operator. However, I have no evidence connecting their business to his committee, and I do not know its membership or purpose beyond the stated description. The arrangements and request for an escort strike me as worth following up, given my feeling that things may be happening without me, but I have seen no evidence of wrongdoing or danger. My neighbour may be able to offer useful local news.
